text:
You don't have to choose between markdown or html files for AI output, you can have both!!!

In fact, I ask my AI to generate 3 outputs
- markdown for another AI consumption
- json structural data for downstream script consumption
- html interactive visualization for human consumption

It is actually not very token expensive, you just have to ask the AI to scaffold the scripts to generate everything.
